# Exiled Casual

> Exiled Casual is a free action role-playing game (ARPG) that runs entirely in a web
> browser, with nothing to install. It is inspired by Path of Exile 1 and 2, borrowing
> the best of each: Atlas map progression, procedurally generated areas, click-to-move
> combat, and deep itemization with prefix/suffix affixes, magic, rare and unique items.
> It is an original game, not affiliated with Grinding Gear Games or Path of Exile.

The game is in active development. The site currently serves a teaser page; the
release date is not announced ("Soon(tm)", the community joke it wears openly).

Key facts:
- Platform: any modern web browser (WebGL2), desktop-focused
- Price: free
- Modes planned: local (browser storage) and online (accounts)
- Engine: TypeScript, React, Babylon.js, deterministic fixed-step simulation
- Developer: IT-BAER

## Links

- [Website](https://exiledcasual.com/): teaser page
- [Source code](https://github.com/IT-BAER/exiled-casual): public development repository
